At $85.67 (Yahoo close 2026-07-20), Lawrence base case implies 12.4% per year over seven years; total synthesis is 14.0%; the decision-grade component contract implies -0.14% per year because net debt and cycle reserve offset the operating engine. industry.structure: Global agricultural supply chain and processing is scale-driven and cyclical: origination, crushing, refining, and nutrition sit on thin margins with periodic crush-spread and freight arbitrage. ADM, Bunge, Cargill, and Louis Dreyfus dominate origination and processing; nutrition and biofuels add higher-margin but smaller revenue pools.
industry.share_shift: ADM is pivoting capital toward nutrition and specialty ingredients (Alltech JV, human/animal nutrition) while core Ag Services and Oilseeds volumes remain tied to global crop flows and China export demand. Peers Bunge and BG are consolidating; ADM's relative share is stable but earnings power is mid-cycle, not peak.
industry.trend: Biofuels policy (renewable diesel, ethanol blending), South American crop competition, and China soybean/meal import patterns drive crush margins. Accounting and intersegment controls remain a governance overhang even after the 2026 SEC settlement.

top_claims.claim: ADM is a scale ag processor and origination network trading at roughly fair value on a filing-grounded component schedule. Normalized owner cash is $6.50 per share (operating cash flow minus an estimated maintenance and growth capital spending haircut). At $85.67 (Yahoo close 2026-07-20), Lawrence base case implies 12.
We expect **12.4%** per year over 7 years at **~$85.67** on **$6.50 per share** starting owner cash (Lawrence base case).
*Primary risk: Crush-margin compression and global trade disruption (especially China soybean/meal flows) reduce owner cash faster than origination scale can offset.
Leverage: $6.6 billion long-term debt versus $1.0 billion cash limits dhando in a prolonged trough.
